What works here, and what needs the full deployment
  • Works in this preview: enter a journey, generate a route, browse route-aware discoveries by corridor and phase, open a place, see its detour cost in extra kilometres and minutes, add and remove stops, and watch the trip-duration impact recalculate.
  • Route and detour figures are ESTIMATES from a simplified offline road network, and the page labels them that way. They are not navigation data.
  • Needs the deployed server: sign-up and sign-in, trips saved to an account, the on-road companion, traveller feedback, and the admin dashboard.
  • Needs the deployed server plus provider keys: real road routing and geocoding, and live place discovery from OpenStreetMap or Google.
  • Not built yet: the interactive map. This preview shows the ROUTE+ vector route map, which is the current renderer.

WHAT ROUTE+ IS

Keep the route.
Choose the experience.

ROUTE+ is route-aware discovery. You already know where you are going. We show what is worth discovering beside that road, what each detour costs in kilometres and time, and whether it still fits your trip.

Recommendations use readable rules, not AI. Each card lists the reasons behind its score. Always confirm opening hours, road conditions and safety locally before you travel.
